decision_so_far: Changed packages/shared/types.ts so the exported Measure type uses the parsed measure schema and requires deviceName.
blocked: The required shared contract change makes npm run build fail in three fixture files outside the spec's allowed paths: packages/collector/meters/utils/utils.test.ts, packages/web/hooks/useWeatherStation.test.ts, and packages/web/weather-dashboard.util.test.ts. Each fixture assigns a Measure without the required deviceName. The existing spec allows packages/shared/types.ts but does not allow those three files.
options: Expand the allowed paths to permit adding deviceName to the three affected fixtures.
Revise the shared contract requirement or constraints so the existing fixtures remain type-correct.
Accept a failed implementation pass with the required Measure contract change and the recorded build errors.
recommendation: Expand the allowed paths to permit updating the three affected fixtures while retaining the required shared Measure contract.

next_steps.builder: Resume after the owner resolves the allowed-path conflict.
next_steps.maestro: Obtain an owner decision and record its resolution in this escalation.

resolution: Owner approved adding packages/collector/meters/utils/utils.test.ts, packages/web/hooks/useWeatherStation.test.ts, and packages/web/weather-dashboard.util.test.ts to the spec's allowed paths. This permits required deviceName fixtures to be updated while keeping Measure.deviceName required.
